files.description: Logical name -> file name within the bundle directory

counted.description: Campsites that count on this section (M2)

published.description: Of those, how many publish an opening season

open.description: Per month: published campsites open all month

partly.description: Per month: published campsites open part of the month

ClimateMonths.description: Monthly normals at the section's climate point (D34).

point.description: ERA5 grid point the values come from

distance_m.description: From the section midpoint to that point

rain_days.description: Share of days with at least the rain-day threshold

wind_along_ms.description: Mean along-route wind riding forward (+ tailwind, - headwind)

ClimateMonths.title: ClimateMonths

Component.description: A continuous piece of a path. Gaps join two ride components and have zero measured length.

straight_distance_m.description: For gaps: straight-line distance between the two ride ends

gap_type.description: For gaps: how the break is crossed

gap_basis.description: For gaps: what the classification rests on

Component.title: Component

school_days.description: Share of the country's regions on school holiday, per month (June-September: no data, as the source omits summer breaks)

school_year.description: Calendar year of the school-holiday dates used

public_holidays.description: Nationwide public holidays in the month

public_year.description: Calendar year of the public-holiday dates used

tourism_index.description: Tourist nights in the month / monthly average (1 = average)

reversed_in_source.description: Track was stored end-to-start in the source GPX

climb_diff_m.description: Reverse climbing minus forward climbing (positive favours forward); null when unknown

ascent_fwd_m.description: Climbing riding forward; null when any of it is unknown

ascent_known_fwd_m.description: When climbing is partly unknown: climbing on the part with real terrain, so a minimum (D37)

climb_unknown_m.description: Length whose climbing is unknown (placeholder track); 0 when complete

max_grade_500m.description: Steepest 500 m, on real terrain only

grade_fwd.description: Rider level (D36) needed to ride the section as one day, forward; a minimum when climbing is partly unknown

surfaces.description: Share of road, cycle_path, gravel and unknown (D36)

remote_share.description: Share of km further than the remoteness distance from a village

accommodation.description: Counted places by kind: campsite, hostel, hotel

longest_gap_m.description: Worst-month longest gap inside the section, per service

station_start.description: A bike-carrying station near the section start (name)

findings.description: Findings overlapping the section, per severity

partial.description: Per month: which best-time inputs had no data (D37)

check.description: Data gaps the rider should check themselves (D37)

label.description: Status label exactly as published, e.g. 'Developed + Signed'

Event.description: One layer value over a stretch of the route (measures in metres on the path axis).
Event.title: Event

LayerInfo.description: A family of events along the route (e.g. surface), with its allowed categorical values.
LayerInfo.title: LayerInfo

MinorSection.description: One ECS minor section (1 km): dominant layer values and indicative criterion results.

values.description: Layer id -> value covering most of this kilometre

MinorSection.title: MinorSection

Place.description:
A service near the route (conflated from OSM and Overture), located on the route's measure axis.

`months` holds one letter per month of the season year (D18): o = open, p = partly (the season starts or ends
that month), c = closed, ? = unknown.

kind.description: Subtype, e.g. campsite, hotel, supermarket, cafe

at_m.description: Measure of the closest route point

access_m.description: Ridden one-way distance from the route; null if no route found

access_min.description: Minutes at touring pace including climbing (D17)

climb_m.description: Net climb from the access point to the place

access_at_m.description: Measure where the rider leaves the route for this place

counts.description: Within the service type's counting limits

months.description: 12 letters, January first: o open, p partly, c closed, ? unknown

sources.description: Source record ids, e.g. osm:n123, overture:<id>

Place.title: Place

ProfileFile.description:
Elevation sampled along the path every `step_m`.

`ele` is the audit's best estimate (smoothed DEM, bridges and tunnels interpolated) when a DEM was used,
otherwise the source GPX elevation. `gpx_ele` always holds the source GPX elevation for comparison.
ProfileFile.title: ProfileFile

RiderLevel.description: D36: what a rider is comfortable riding per day, with luggage.
RiderLevel.title: RiderLevel

hard.description: A stretch may not continue across this break

ascent_m.description: Climbing; a minimum when climb_unknown_m > 0 (unknown terrain is left out, D37)

climb_unknown_m.description: Length whose terrain is unknown (long straight-line placeholders); 0 when climbing is complete

max_grade_500m.description: Steepest 500 m average gradient (%) in travel direction

shares.description: Layer id -> value -> share of length (0-1)

essential_pass.description: Share of length meeting all essential criteria

important_pass.description: Share of length meeting all important criteria

counts.description: Service id -> places that count on this daily section

longest_gap_m.description: Service id -> longest stretch inside the section without the service, per month (Jan-Dec)

unknown_hours.description: Service id -> share of counted places with unknown months

blocks.description: Fixed 50 km live-data blocks as [from_m, to_m]

minor.description: Fixed 1 km ECS minor sections as [from_m, to_m]

ServiceGap.description: A stretch without a service, at least half as long as the stretch that triggers a finding.

service.description: Service id, or bail_out for stations that carry bikes within bail-out reach

month.description: 0-11: counting places not known closed that month; null: any month

threshold_m.description: Gap length that triggers a finding for this service

ServiceGap.title: ServiceGap

ServiceType.description: A kind of service along the route, with the access limits that decide whether a place counts (D17).

count_m.description: Ridden one-way distance within which a place counts

count_min.description: Time cap (flat speed plus climbing) for counting; null = none

show_m.description: Places up to this ridden distance are kept for display

gap_m.description: A stretch this long without the service gives a finding

gap_also.description: Other services that also fill this one's gaps (shops sell water)

ServiceType.title: ServiceType

route_longest_gap_m.description: Service id -> longest gap per month

season_known.description: Service id -> share of counted places whose opening season is published (any month known)

file.description: Path relative to the data directory
